svg.title: Card Reader card database relationships
svg.desc: Orthogonal database diagram with import lineage across the top and separate bands for card consumers, stable card identity, version and review lineage, and version metadata. Relationship lines use open routing lanes around entity boxes and separate attachment segments at every destination. Small gaps mark independent lane crossovers.
svg.text: Orthogonal routing keeps every relationship outside entity boxes. Shared travel trunks split into dedicated attachment segments before reaching a model.
Import lineage / parser output / external actors
id, label; key unique per pool/factions
lifecycle + deck config • latest_version • back override
exactly one Tag, Type, or Symbol source
Relationship geometry: orthogonal lanes only • no entity-box crossings • dedicated destination attachments • small gaps mark independent lane crossovers
